TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Obtains information about the pricing rule. Allows you to filter by various parameters.
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: 1. Input and validations: execute() retrieves the input parameters, validates pricingRuleId with if(this.getPricingruleid() !=null && this.getPricingruleid() < 0), emits ABKO00000050 in execute(), sets Severity.WARN, assigns an empty pricingRules list in DataPricingRuleGet, calls setDataofpricingrules, and returns. 2. Decisions and branches: when pricingRuleId is not negative, execute() populates PricingRuleGetFilterParams and calls ABKOR000.executeGetPricingRules; inside ABKOR000Impl.callPricingRulesDataBase, pageNumber defaults to 1 and pageSize defaults to 10 when they are null or not greater than 0, pricingRuleStatus sets statusFlag to FILTERED only when the list is not empty, pricingRuleType sets typeFlag to FILTERED only when the list is not empty, and if totalElements equals "0" the method assigns an empty pricingRules list instead of querying rows. 3. Invoked libraries and methods: execute() calls ABKOR000.executeGetPricingRules with PricingRuleGetFilterParams; ABKOR000Impl.executeGetPricingRules delegates to callPricingRulesDataBase, which builds base query parameters, converts fromDate and toDate with Utils.convertDateForOracle, expands pricingRuleStatus in buildStatusListAndFlag, expands pricingRuleType in buildTypeListAndFlag, executes GET_COUNT_QUERY, builds PaginationDTO in buildPaginationDTO, executes GET_PRICING_RULES_QUERY when totalElements is not "0", maps each row in mapToPricingRuleGetDTO, maps activities in mapActivities, maps segment and settlement in mapRelatedEntity, maps paymentMethods in Utils.mapPaymentMethodsFromListAgg, and maps customAttributes in Utils.mapCustomAttributesFromListAgg. 4. Errors and subsequent actions: execute() emits ABKO00000050 when pricingRuleId is not null and less than 0, sets Severity.WARN, assigns an empty pricingRules list, and returns; execute() emits ABKO00000040 when dataPricingRuleGet.getPricingRules().isEmpty() after ABKOR000.executeGetPricingRules returns, sets Severity.WARN, and continues to assign the response. 5. Outputs and assignment conditions: ABKOR000Impl.callPricingRulesDataBase always sets paginationOut with buildPaginationDTO, sets pricingRules to Collections.emptyList() when totalElements equals "0", otherwise assigns the mapped list returned from mapToPricingRuleGetDTO, and execute() always calls setDataofpricingrules with the resulting DataPricingRuleGet, including the early return branch with an empty pricingRules list.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Retrieves pricing rules by building query parameters, applying status and type filters, calculating pagination, and mapping each returned row into DataPricingRuleGet.
